title: Why my résumé chatbot shows its sources
summary: The Ask me chat on this site answers only from my résumé — and tags every claim with the line it came from. Here's how, and why I think every assistant should work this way.

title: The digit reader that read every 7 as a 3
summary: A 98%-accurate model that failed on the first numbers I drew. The bug wasn't in the model — it was in the pixels I fed it.
